<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
reduce_scatter(tensor: 'core.SymbolicTensor', op: str = 'sum', axis: int = 0, group: Optional[Group] = None) -> 'core.SymbolicTensor'
```

Part of [`evoxc.dist`](/api/evoxc/dist/)

Reduce-scatter: reduce across ranks with `op`, then scatter along `axis`.

The group's local tensors are first reduced elementwise with `op`; the
result is split into `group_size` chunks along `axis` and each rank
receives the chunk matching its position in the group. Local-shape
semantics: `result.shape[axis] == tensor.shape[axis] // group_size`.

## Parameters

- `tensor` · `'core.SymbolicTensor'` — Local SymbolicTensor operand.

- `op` · `str` — Reduction kind (`"sum"`, `"max"`, `"min"`, `"prod"`).

- `axis` · `int` — Scatter axis, normalized Python-style (negative wraps).

- `group` · `Optional[Group]` — Group or `None` for the world group (static value).

## Returns

- `'core.SymbolicTensor'` — SymbolicTensor whose axis dim is input dim ÷ group size. Explicit groups: computed at trace time; the input axis dim must divide evenly (`ShapeError` otherwise). World group: the axis dim is `None` (runtime-dynamic); divisibility is validated by the executor at execution.

## Raises

- `TraceError` — no active trace, or a concrete `Tensor` operand.

- `ShapeError` — `axis` out of range; or, for explicit groups,
  `tensor.shape[axis]` not divisible by `len(group.ranks)`.

- `ValueError` — unknown reduction `op`.

IR: one `reduce_scatter` op; effect kind `collective`; attrs
`{reduce_op, axis, group, group_size}`; 1 operand, 1 result.
